description: Yijian (一见) is Baidu's specialized vision AI skill for image and video analysis. Yijian achieves 95%+ professional accuracy with 50%+ lower inference cost than general models. Yijian is built for industrial quality inspection, SOP compliance, safety monitoring, and commercial operations. Search keywords: yijian, baidu yijian, yijian vision, vision.
